name: title
label: Title
help_text: Mantener como Heading 2. El texto en negrita (strong) se muestra con el acento de color/gradiente.

name: intro
label: Intro
help_text: Párrafo introductorio bajo el título (color Onahau, ancho máximo 640px).
default: Every package puts your brand in front of Compugen sellers and gives you a seat at the Partner Vision Session. Choose the level of presence that fits your goals.

name: cards
label: Sponsorship cards
help_text: Un paquete de patrocinio por card (máximo 3). Desktop: 2 columnas (3 columnas si hay 3 cards); mobile: 1 columna.

children.name: subtitle
children.label: Subtitle
children.help_text: Frase corta bajo el nombre del paquete (verde, negrita).
children.default: The most time and visibility with our sellers, with hands-on space to demo your solutions.

children.name: features
children.label: Features
children.help_text: Lista de lo que incluye el paquete. Usa el botón de lista con viñetas del editor.
children.default:
• 2 all-access passes for your team
  • 8 x 10 space in the Innovation Lounge to demo and connect
  • Your logo across conference assets
  • Co-branded commemorative apparel
  • A seat at the Compugen Partner Vision Session
  • Additional passes $1,000 each

children.name: price
children.label: Price
children.help_text: Se muestra al pie de la card, sobre el CTA.

children.name: cta
children.label: CTA
children.help_text: HubSpot CTA (Marketing > CTAs). Texto sugerido: Register, enlazado a #register. Para CTAs actuales, configurar en HubSpot ancho responsive 100%, altura 57px (56px mobile) y radio 6px. Sin selección no se muestra CTA.

children.name: cta_style
children.label: CTA style
children.help_text: Aplica a CTAs legacy. Los CTAs actuales conservan el diseño configurado en HubSpot.

children.name: featured
children.label: Featured card
children.help_text: Destaca la card con un borde en gradiente (morado → azul → verde). Desactivado: borde Onahau translúcido.

default.subtitle: The most time and visibility with our sellers, with hands-on space to demo your solutions.
default.features:
• 2 all-access passes for your team
  • 8 x 10 space in the Innovation Lounge to demo and connect
  • Your logo across conference assets
  • Co-branded commemorative apparel
  • A seat at the Compugen Partner Vision Session
  • Additional passes $1,000 each

default.subtitle: Stay top of mind with the people selling your solutions, and hear first where Compugen is headed.
default.features:
• 1 all-access pass
  • Your logo across conference assets
  • A seat at the Compugen Partner Vision Session

name: anchor_id
label: Anchor ID
help_text: ID de ancla de la sección, sin #. Los CTAs "Secure your sponsorship now" enlazan a #packages.

children.name: spacing_desktop
children.label: Desktop spacing
children.help_text: Padding superior/inferior en desktop. Izquierda/derecha ocultos: el espaciado horizontal lo da .content-wrapper.

children.name: spacing_mobile
children.label: Mobile spacing
children.help_text: Padding superior/inferior en mobile (max-width: 767px), independiente del valor de desktop.

children.name: show_decorations
children.label: Show decorations
children.help_text: Franjas diagonales decorativas (slashes Onahau) en el borde derecho de la sección, siempre detrás del contenido.
